findings.location: Facts & Assumptions [F12] (currently line 104); historical version observed before the concurrent producer correction.
findings.evidence: The observed F12 asserted the real cross-product norm identity for complex-bilinear vectors without a real-vector restriction. For u=(1,i,0), v=(1,-i,0), the squared usual complex norm of u×v is 4, whereas the asserted right side is 0. The cited thm-cross-product-norm-is-the-two-vector-gram-determinant applies only to real vectors. The producer subsequently corrected F12 to restrict the identity to real vectors; that correction closes the defect for the actual current/kernel estimates. This records the historical observation, not a defect in the corrected paragraph. Original observed bytes were not hash-bound, so observed_source is null.
